component.name: Waydroid Profile Manager
component.summary: Apply resolution, density and orientation profiles to Waydroid

description.p: Waydroid Profile Manager applies saved display profiles to a running Waydroid session: host window resolution, Android display density and orientation, in one click with progress reporting.
The current configuration is backed up before anything is changed, so Reset puts the previous resolution, density and rotation settings back.

ul.li: Switch between resolution profiles with a single click
Portrait and landscape orientations per profile
Backup and restore of the previous display configuration
Create, duplicate, import and export custom profiles as JSON
Live progress log while a profile is applied

screenshot.caption: Dashboard with Waydroid status, active profile and orientation selector
Live log of status updates and applied actions

description.p: Fixes on KDE Plasma: the window no longer shows a duplicated title bar (the GTK header bar was stacked on top of the window manager decoration); the window manager title bar now shows the app icon and a friendly title. The tarball installer points the menu entry at the absolute binary path so it launches even when ~/.local/bin is not in the session PATH yet.
